response.sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_quantity, AVG(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost != 0 THEN (derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / derived_total_cost ELSE NULL END) as avg_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) as overall_avg_quantity FROM invoice_stats WHERE avg_quantity IS NOT NULL), filtered_invoices AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, i.avg_quantity, i.avg_gap, i.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg_quantity as quantity_above_avg FROM invoice_stats i CROSS JOIN overall_avg o WHERE i.avg_quantity IS NOT NULL AND i.avg_quantity > o.overall_avg_quantity) SELECT invoice_number, avg_quantity, avg_gap, quantity_above_avg FROM filtered_invoices ORDER BY quantity_above_avg IS NULL, quantity_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10;
